title: System Administrator
summary: A system administrator keeps a company's servers, user accounts and core IT services running, patched and backed up. They sit in the IT operations or infrastructure team and handle requests and incidents through ITIL processes.
dailyDuties: Administer Linux and Windows servers, services and storage
Manage Active Directory users, groups and Group Policy
Run virtual machines on VMware vSphere or Hyper-V
Patch servers on schedule and close scan findings
Handle incidents, requests and changes through ITIL processes
Automate routine tasks with Bash or PowerShell and write runbooks

Run virtual machines on VMware vSphere or Hyper-V
Automate routine admin tasks with scripts

Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP and basic connectivity
Run backups, test restores and support recovery plans
Patch servers on schedule and close scan findings
Handle incidents, requests and changes through ITIL processes
Set up alerts for server health
Run servers on a public cloud
Run servers and identity on a public cloud
Automate configuration with Ansible or similar
Write runbooks and explain issues to users
